deep.reconstruction:
This page has no mathematics. It is the inside front cover, or the front pastedown/flyleaf, of the bound volume now catalogued as Cod. Ms. Gauß, Handbuch 5. It is held at the Niedersächsische Staats- und Universitätsbibliothek Göttingen, and the bundle here is labelled 'HB.Brouillons1805'.

The page carries two later library additions:
(1) A pencil shelfmark in a modern librarian's hand: 'Cod. MS Gauß, Handbuch 5'.
(2) A pasted printed label: 'Auch als Mikroform vorhanden unter Sign.:'. Typewritten after it is 'MF Cod.Ms.Gauss Handb.5'. The label says the volume is also available on microform under that shelfmark.

Nothing on the page is in Gauss's hand. There are no computations, formulas or derivations to reconstruct.
